definitions: Past participle of "underwrite", meaning to sign and accept liability under an insurance policy, thus guaranteeing payment in case loss or damage occurs.
Past participle of "underwrite", meaning to undertake to finance or support by guaranteeing to buy at a stated price all the new shares or stock not bought by the public.
Past participle of "underwrite", meaning to support financially.
examples: The new policy has been underwritten by a consortium of insurers.
The bond issue was underwritten by a major investment bank.
The project was underwritten by a generous grant.
